item.title: commandline: From custom infrastructure to hosted agents
item.description:
Novo rebuilt its clinical trials data agent on Microsoft Foundry, moving from custom infrastructure to hosted agents. The reported benefits are a simpler operating model, stronger session isolation, and a clearer path from tracing to evaluation and optimization.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
